overal.goal: Pin webhook connections to the address the SSRF guard checked. The guard resolves the target host, but fetch resolves it again, so a TTL-0 DNS-rebinding answer can swap in a private address between the two lookups. Connect to the checked address instead (undici `Agent({ connect: { lookup } })` whose lookup returns the validated address), keeping the Host header and TLS server name. Needs undici as a new dependency: get the owner's approval of the dependency first.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Filed by the group 3 review (M3); not started. Blocked on owner approval of the undici dependency.

Done without a new dependency: deliveries go through pinnedPost (packages/web/src/pinned-post.ts), node:http(s).request with a lookup that returns only the addresses checkWebhookTarget approved (all of them when the runtime asks for a list), so the name is not resolved a second time; the URL host stays the Host header and the TLS server name (checked against a self-signed certificate by hand). No redirects, no connection reuse (agent: false). Exempted hosts (allowedPrivateWebhookHosts) resolve normally. undici was therefore not needed.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
